description: Generate a tint-to-shade color ramp from a base CSS color. Returns an ordered list of swatches (light → dark) each with its in-gamut hex, display-rounded OKLCH components (l/c 5dp, h 2dp), WCAG contrast ratios (2dp) + tiers vs white and black, and an in-gamut flag. Optionally emits the ramp as design tokens via tokenFormat ("tailwind" JSON or a "css-variables" :root block).

base.description: Any CSS color string, e.g. "#3b82f6", "oklch(0.6 0.35 30)" (max 256 chars)

deltaL.description: Total lightness span (> 0) centered on the base L — endpoints at base L ± deltaL/2 (overrides the fixed range).

tokenFormat.description: Optional design-token format for the ramp ("tailwind" JSON object or a "css-variables" :root block); when present the output includes a `tokens` string.

tokenName.description: Base name for emitted tokens (letters/digits/hyphens, must start with a letter, 1-64 chars). Default "color".

name: generate_ramp

hex.description: Lowercase #rrggbb sRGB-clamped hex of the swatch

inGamut.description: false when the swatch fell outside the sRGB gamut

oklch.description: Requested-L / clampChroma OKLCH projection, display-rounded (l/c 5dp, h 2dp; may differ slightly from hex; preserves L monotonicity)

c.description: OKLCH chroma, display-rounded to 5 decimal places

h.description: OKLCH hue in degrees, display-rounded to 2 decimal places

l.description: OKLCH lightness, display-rounded to 5 decimal places

step.description: Zero-based swatch index (0 is the lightest end)

vsBlack.description: WCAG contrast of this swatch against black

ratio.description: WCAG ratio vs black (2-decimal display value; tier derives from the unrounded raw ratio)

tier.description: WCAG tier (AAA/AA/FAIL) of ratio vs black

vsWhite.description: WCAG contrast of this swatch against white

ratio.description: WCAG ratio vs white (2-decimal display value; tier derives from the unrounded raw ratio)

tier.description: WCAG tier (AAA/AA/FAIL) of ratio vs white

tokens.description: Design-token string for the ramp (pretty-printed Tailwind JSON or a :root CSS-variables block); present only when tokenFormat was supplied
